**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

- **What exists:** Section 15.11 (p0833) is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential/punitive damages only; the arbitration clause (p0830) repeats a mutual consequential/punitive waiver. Searches for "aggregate liability", "exceed", "in no event", "gross negligence" confirm no monetary cap or carve-out architecture anywhere, including Article 12 (indemnification/insurance).
- **Why it fails fallback:** no aggregate cap at all, so PB's direct liability is uncapped and there are no Excluded Claims for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence or willful misconduct.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence pair at 15.11.1 creating a mutual cap at twelve months' fees with those four carve-outs — fallback level, no preferred extras (USD 1,000,000 floor, data protection, fraud, IP) volunteered. The retained sentence preserving PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payment obligations remains consistent with the new cap.
